Maya (AE): NovaRetail asks for a focused perf run: short 1-3s sessions, repeated microbursts up to ~250 qps for 20-45s, then idle. They need p50/p95/p99, error %, cold vs primed, and KMS notes. SE/Eng can propose a plan + quick cost delta?
Sam (SE): Plan: (A) cold-check: single 45s burst @150 qps from cold start (no warmup). (B) priming: 5m warm at 40-50 qps. (C) burst sweep: 45s bursts at 50/100/150/200/250 qps with 3m idle between. Capture p50/p95/p99, errors, GPU util, tokens/sec.
Sam (SE): Minimal harness (adaptable):
./bench --endpoint https://api.redwood/v1/generate --model open-13b-q4f32 --seq 200 --burst-profile "45s@250,180s@0" --repeat 5 --out csv
Devon (Eng): Runtime hints: prefix_cache=on (200MB), batch.max_tokens=2048, batch.time_ms=8, async_kv_prefetch=true. Autoscale: enable burst buffer with 120s cooldown. For Dedicated recommend small reserved pool + 2x short burst headroom.
Devon (Eng): Quick internal reference numbers (open-13b-q4): 30s@250 -> p50~80ms, p95~220ms, p99~420ms, errors~0.3%. Cold-first-burst example: p95~540ms, errors~1.5%.
Priya (Security): KMS: we support cloud KMS HSM or customer HSM for Dedicated/Private. Need to confirm rotation cadence, offline wrapping, and load-generator IP allowlist. Fed-like controls -> Private deploy + audit retention (timeline + cost impact).
Maya (AE): Pricing ask: Tom, rough delta for bursty vs per-token?
Sam (SE): Back-of-envelope: hosted per-1k tokens ~ $0.12. Bursty without reserved can increase effective cost ~1.2-1.7x. With small reserved pool sized for steady+25% headroom, delta ~1.05-1.25x. Exact numbers after cluster sizing.
Tom (Prospect): We can give two 2-hour windows. Want cold vs warm results and a short runbook. Also confirm keys stay in our KMS if Dedicated.
Sam (SE): We'll deliver CSVs, charts, short runbook. For Dedicated keys can remain in your KMS; hosted has wrapping options. Priya will follow up.
Maya (AE): I'll book Wed 10am PT. Sam/Devon attach harness + checklist and I'll send invite.
